test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: With which of the following institutions is the name of Madan Mohan Malaviya associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banaras Hindu University**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Banaras Hindu University which completed **100 years in February 2016** was founded by Madan Mohan Malaviya.
 
• The University had organized a centenary seminar on higher education and the contribution of BHU to mark this occasion.
 
• It was founded in the year 1916.
 
• He was the Vice-Chancellor of Banaras Hindu University from 1919–1938.
 
• Madan Malviya publicly announced his intent to establish a university in **Varanasi at the 21st Conference of the Indian National Congress in Benaras in December 1905.**
 
• The "Mahamana" title was conferred to Madan Malviya by Mahatma Gandhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College** was founded in the year **1875 **by sir **Syed Ahmed Khan.**
 
• **Fort William College** was started by **Lord Wellesley in the year 1800.**
 
• Presidency University, Kolkata, formerly known as Hindu College.
 
 
• The College was formally opened on Monday, 20 January 1817.
